description.value: Steveston Built Local Taphouse is a neighbourhood pub situated near the historic Steveston waterfront in Richmond, an area well-travelled by cyclists on the dike trails and coastal routes. The taphouse bills itself as locally focused, with its menu available as a PDF download from the website. It occupies a unit in a mixed-use development at the edge of the Steveston community.
